product_title: Handcrafted Floral Pearl Tealight Holder Set
product_description: Enhance your festive decor with this elegant handcrafted floral tealight holder set. Featuring vibrant magenta roses, delicate white flowers, decorative pink floral accents, intricate golden metal holders, and a beautiful pearl border, these pieces bring a luxurious and graceful touch to your home. The combination of rich floral colours and golden detailing makes this set perfect for Diwali celebrations, pooja arrangements, festive table decor, wedding decorations, and special occasions. Add warmth and timeless elegance to your celebrations with this beautiful decorative set.
product_care_suggestion: Gently remove dust using a soft, dry cloth or a soft-bristled brush.
Avoid water, excessive moisture, and harsh cleaning chemicals to protect the flowers and decorative finish.
Keep the artificial flowers and pearl embellishments away from direct heat and open flames.
If using tealight candles, ensure the candle flame does not come into direct contact with the holder to prevent damage.
Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight to preserve the vibrant colours and golden finish.
Handle the artificial flowers, pearl borders, and decorative elements carefully to prevent damage or detachment.
Store in a dry place in a protective box or fabric bag when not in use.
